title: Basis expansion for constant-section tensor coefficient presheaves
statement: For a field k [def-weil-field], a scheme Y [def-pc-scheme] with structure morphism g:Y → Spec(k), a k-module M, a sheaf G of O_Y-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], and a k-basis b:I→M, the presheaf coproduct of I copies of G.val [def-weil-presheaf-modules-sheafification] is isomorphic to picardConstantSectionsTensor k Y g M G. This constructed object tensors G.val with the presheaf scalar extension of the constant M presheaf along the constant-ring map induced by g [def-sc-field-linear-module-cohomology-operations]. All types and schemes lie in the same universe. This uses no quasi-coherence or geometry of a first factor.

source.place: Tag 0BED, lemma-kunneth, affine-open degree-zero calculation; read at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/0BED

proof.text: Use the basis representation b.repr to identify the constant vector presheaf with the free module presheaf on the constant type I. The component is b.repr.symm; naturality is checked on free generators, where both restriction maps are identities.

Compose the free-presheaf adjunction over the constant ring with the pullback-pushforward adjunction along the structure ring map [def-sc-field-linear-module-cohomology-operations]. For the identity functor on opens, pushforward followed by forgetting scalars is definitionally the target forgetful functor. Uniqueness of left adjoints therefore identifies scalar extension of the free constant-I presheaf with the free constant-I presheaf over the structure ring.

Construct the coproduct cofan of copies of the unit into the free constant-I presheaf by its generator sections i. For any cofan t, the descent map sends the i-th generator on U to t.inj(i).app(U)(1). Naturality follows from naturality of the unit maps. The factorization identities follow by evaluating unit maps at 1; uniqueness follows by free-module generator extensionality on each open. Thus the free presheaf is the coproduct of copies of the unit, also for empty I.

Compose these isomorphisms to identify the scalar-extended constant vector presheaf with the coproduct of unit presheaves. Mathlib proves that pointwise tensorRight G.val preserves coproducts. Its coproduct comparison and the left unitors give the coproduct of copies of G.val. Tensor the scalar-extension isomorphism with the identity of G.val and compose.

proof_origin.place: Tag 0BED, lemma-kunneth, second isomorphism in the ordinary direct-image degree-zero calculation; read at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/0BED. theorem exists_picard_constant_sections_tensor_basis
    (k : Type w) [Field k] (Y : Scheme.{w})
    (g : Y ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) (M : ModuleCat.{w} k) (G : Y.Modules)
    (I : Type w) (b : Module.Basis I k M) :
    Nonempty ((∐ fun _ : I ↦ G.val) ≅ picardConstantSectionsTensor k Y g M G)
